items.summary_en: University students gathered at Syntagma Square in Athens to demand action on the housing problem. They then held a protest at the Finance Ministry. The group asked the government to take measures to ease the housing burden.

items.summary_en: Bianneider Tamayo is a Venezuelan defender for Universidad de Chile. He will be the only player in the squad with no days off after returning from national team duty. The club gave him a special training plan.

items.raw_excerpt: Novas regras entraram em vigor nesta terça-feira (13). Infrações podem gerar multas no valor de R$ 130,16.
items.summary_en: São Paulo began enforcing new traffic rules for electric bikes and scooters on Tuesday, October 13. Riders who break the rules can be fined 130.16 reals.

items.summary_en: Lisbon has been named Europe's Best Cruise Destination. The award comes in the same year the Lisbon Cruise Terminal was nominated for Europe's Best Cruise Terminal for a sixth time. The honour highlights the city's growing appeal to cruise travellers.

items.summary_en: South Africa's education department told a parliamentary committee that 76,000 matric candidates are progressed learners. The department and Umalusi briefed the committee on exam readiness.

items.raw_excerpt: Primo reconheceu o gesto feito por menina de 9 anos abordada por um homem e pediu ajuda
items.summary_en: A 9-year-old girl in Curitiba used a universal help signal when a man approached her. Her cousin noticed the gesture and asked for help. Officials say the case shows why people should learn the signal.
items.summary_ko: 쿠리치바의 한 9세 소녀가 남성이 다가오자 공통 구조 신호를 냈다. 사촌이 이 제스처를 알아채고 도움을 요청했다. 당국은 이 사례가 그 신호를 왜 알아야 하는지 보여준다고 말했다.
items.title_en: Curitiba case shows importance of universal help signal

items.raw_excerpt: Está ubicado a 69 kilómetros de la capital provincial y combina un embalse de 1500 hectáreas, playas sobre la costa y actividades de aventura en plena cordillera de los Andes.
items.summary_en: This small town in Mendoza has about 2,000 residents. It sits 69 kilometers from the provincial capital, with a 1,500-hectare reservoir, beaches, and adventure activities in the Andes. Thousands of tourists visit every year.
